verdict.line: You lose if you let Malphite farm free Q pokes and hit level 6 with you low; you win if you abuse levels 1-2 and deny his Granite Shield resets.

brief.thesis: Malphite's passive Granite Shield absorbs a chunk of poke damage whenever it's charged, so your ranged Cannon Stance harass only matters if you can hit him before the shield resets — otherwise he just walks even trades off and punishes your mana with Q (Seismic Shard, 8s cooldown). The data backs this up directly: 43.3% Jayce win rate over 7,606 games, with Malphite favored for both lane and solo-kill equity.

theirWindow.when: shield charged, you're in Q range
theirWindow.what: He'll walk up and let you hit the shield for free, then punish your follow-up with Seismic Shard (Q) since it steals your Move Speed on impact — don't chain poke into a charged shield, you're just feeding it.

yourWindow.when: shield depleted, levels 1-2 before his W (Brutal Strikes) is online
yourWindow.what: Hammer Stance E (Thundering Blow, 20s cooldown at rank 1) knocks him back on cooldown resets — use it to punish any approach, then swap to Cannon Stance and poke with autos while the shield is down. This is your cleanest damage window all lane.

powerCurve.note: Shield down, E knockback punishes approaches
Brutal Strikes online, trades even out
Muramana online, poke damage scales back up
Full build outranges his engage entirely

start.why: 76.5% pick rate and the better winrate of the two starts (43.4% vs 43.8% — Doran's Shield only wins by raw survivability, not by trading better); the extra AD helps your early Hammer Stance pokes actually threaten the shield.

boots.why: 46.3% win rate, the magic resist directly blunts Ground Slam (E) and Unstoppable Force (R) burst, both of which scale off his armor and hit hard from level 6 on.

core.why: Builds toward Muramana — you need the mana pool to spam Cannon Stance poke without being starved by Seismic Shard trades.
Armor shred lets your autos and Shock Blast actually punish his Brutal Strikes-buffed armor instead of bouncing off it.
Core damage spike — this is what flips your poke from 'annoying' to 'threatening' once his shield can't keep up.
Cooldown reduction on your stance-swap combat loop, letting you cycle Hammer/Cannon abilities faster than he can recharge Granite Shield.

situational.when: the enemy team stacks shields or you're facing a second shield-reliant champion
you're ahead and want to burst him down in the all-in window before his shield resets
you need to close the gap faster for Hammer Stance E resets in skirmishes
you want a cheaper lane-phase damage spike before committing to Muramana

runes.keystoneWhy: 44.7% win rate and the safer pick into a lane where Malphite's shield soaks your poke — Grasp's sustain lets you out-trade through the shield recharge cycles instead of losing the war of attrition. Master-tier players instead run Stormraider's Surge (Sorcery) across 25,501 games, which suits players comfortable kiting Unstoppable Force with movement speed rather than tanking through it.

summoners.why: 73.6% pick rate and the highest win rate (43.2%) — Teleport lets you reset after shoving with Cannon Stance poke, which matters more here than Ignite since you're not winning most all-in trades before level 6.

playing.title: Check shield before every poke
playing.detail: Only commit Cannon Stance autos or Shock Blast (Q) when Granite Shield is visibly down — hitting a charged shield wastes mana and gives him a free Seismic Shard punish.

playing.title: Abuse levels 1-2 hard
playing.detail: Before his W (Brutal Strikes) is slotted, Hammer Stance E (Thundering Blow) knockback punishes every approach for free — this is your only clean edge on the power curve.

playing.title: Play around level 6 explicitly
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force has a long cooldown (130s at rank 1, down to 80s at rank 5) but one connect can kill you outright per OP.GG's own warning — buy toward health-scaling items and don't overextend past minion wave once he hits 6.

playing.title: Track your own mana bar
playing.detail: Cannon Stance poke drains mana fast and Tear of the Goddess doesn't finish early — don't poke past 50% mana before level 6 or you'll have nothing left to answer his all-in.

playing.title: Use Acceleration Gate for disengage
playing.detail: Cannon Stance E deploys a Move Speed gate for allies — place it facing your tower so you can kite out of Unstoppable Force range if he commits post-6.

playing.title: Shred armor before committing full combos
playing.detail: Black Cleaver's stacking armor shred is what makes your mid-game trades actually outpace his Brutal Strikes buff — don't all-in until you've landed a few autos to apply it.

playing.title: Don't chase past minion wave
playing.detail: His W (Brutal Strikes) hits everything in front of him and buffs his damage/armor for its duration — walking into melee range to chase is how you lose trades you were winning at range.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the 43.3% head-to-head winrate are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the tactical reading — shield timing, level 1-2 window, when to commit — is my own analysis of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful when Malphite reaches level 6 and purchase items that have bonus health to avoid being nuked. Keep your Conqueror stacks up.
